topics: Type of contracts (Lump sum, item rate, EPC, BOT etc..)
Indian Contract Act 1872 – Layout and Salient Features - Performance and Non-performance of Contract - Breach of Contract - Consequences and Remedies - Liquidated Damages
Contract Documentation-Form of Agreement & Hierarchy of Terms and Conditions- Typical structure of contract- Preamble
Scope and Specifications- Preliminaries and General - Insurance policies
Terms of Payment- Price adjustment- Assignments and Subcontracting
Evaluation of bid and award of contract
Standard Forms of Contracts - FIDIC form of Contract

Performance Bond - Programme of Work – Submissions and approvals - Progress Review Meetings - Certification and Interim Payments - Quality and Safety - Variation clauses and changes to the scope of work - Claims - Delay and disruption - Force majeure and Exceptional events - Suspension & Termination - Taking over and Substantial completion - Release of Performance Bond/Security - Defect Liability and Release of Retention Money - Contract closure and Final

Conflicts, Disputes, and their causes - Conflict avoidance and tiered dispute resolution clauses - Alternative Dispute Resolution Methods & Litigation - Best practices in dispute resolution and management - General Provisions - Arbitration Agreement
